# Excel environment differences

<!-- generated by `efh environments render` from content/evidence/environments/*.json; edits here are overwritten -->

Excel's worksheet functions are assumed to give the same result for the same inputs in every
Excel build, on every platform (Windows, Mac, web; 32- or 64-bit) and on every CPU. Every
reading the Handbook records names the Excel build, platform and CPU it was taken in, where
these were recorded. When two environments give different results for the same inputs, the
difference is rechecked and recorded here, function by function, with the exact inputs
(binary64 bits as well as a decimal display), each result, and where each observation is kept.

This page is generated from the per-function records in
[`content/evidence/environments/`](environments/); the format is described in
[`data/README.md`](../../data/README.md#excel-environment-differences) and
[`tools/schemas/f19-excel-environments.schema.json`](../../tools/schemas/f19-excel-environments.schema.json).

## Summary

- Functions with recorded readings: 287 (of the 541 entries = 518 functions + 23 operators).
- Excel environments named: 6.
- Same-input comparisons between environments: 87, over 57 functions.
- Differences observed: 0, in 0 functions.
- Expected but untested sensitivities: 32, over 30 functions.
- Functions read in one environment only: 190.

A function without a record here has no reading recorded in this family. A function read in one
environment only has no known difference because nothing has been compared, not because its
results are known to agree elsewhere.

## Known differences

None. No reading in the seeded evidence shows Excel giving different results for the same
inputs in two environments. The comparisons below say how far that has been tested.
